description: This file defines the Donation class and related functions for handling donations, including webhook processing for Razorpay, creating donors, and payment entries within the ERPNext non-profit module.

classes.name: Donation
classes.description: A Document class representing a donation, with methods for validation, creating payment entries, and handling donor creation.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates the donation, ensuring donor exists or creating one for web forms.

methods.name: create_donor_for_website_user
methods.description: Creates a donor record for a website user if it does not already exist.

methods.name: on_payment_authorized
methods.description: Handles actions after payment authorization, such as creating payment entries.

methods.name: create_payment_entry
methods.description: Creates and submits a payment entry for the donation.
